notes: ONFI defines a per-LUN Status Register (1 byte, read via 70h / 78h), a 256-byte Parameter Page (read via ECh), a 16-byte Unique ID (read via EDh), an Extended Parameter Page (variable, when 256 B is insufficient), and a Feature parameter file (4 bytes per feature address, set/get via EFh / EEh). There is no traditional memory-mapped register block — all device state is accessed through command-addressed reads from the device.

registers.name: Status Register
registers.access: Read via Read Status (70h) and Read Status Enhanced (78h); 1-byte response on DQ.
registers.description: If the RDY bit is 0, all other bits (except WP_n) are invalid and shall be ignored by the host.

fields.name: WP_n
fields.description: 0 = device is write-protected, 1 = not write-protected. Always valid regardless of RDY.

fields.name: RDY
fields.description: 1 = LUN ready for another command and all other status bits valid; 0 = previous command not yet complete; SR[5:0] are invalid. Drives R/B_n in inverted sense.

fields.name: ARDY
fields.description: 1 = no array operation in progress; 0 = command is being processed (RDY=0) OR an array operation is in progress. Not used when overlapped multi-plane / cache commands are not supported.

fields.name: VSP
fields.description: Vendor Specific. Reserved for vendor use.

fields.name: CSP
fields.description: Command Specific. For EZ NAND Read this bit set = ECC threshold exceeded (rewrite recommended). For other operations this bit is reserved. When FAIL=1, CSP is don't-care.

fields.name: FAILC
fields.description: 1 = command issued prior to the last command failed; valid only for Page Cache Program operations after the second 15h or 10h transfer. For EZ NAND, not used (cache commands unsupported).

fields.name: FAIL
fields.description: 1 = last command failed. Valid for Program/Erase on raw NAND; valid for Read/Program/Erase on EZ NAND. During program cache, only valid when ARDY=1. Also indicates ZQ calibration failure on devices supporting ZQ.

registers.name: Parameter Page
registers.access: Read via Read Parameter Page (ECh + 00h address); 256 bytes + 2 redundant copies + optional extras.
registers.description: Self-describing device geometry / capability table. Byte 0-3 signature 'ONFI' (4Fh, 4Eh, 46h, 49h). Bytes 254-255 = Integrity CRC. Bytes 256-511 = Redundant Parameter Page 1; bytes 512-767 = Redundant Parameter Page 2; bytes 768+ = additional redundant copies.

fields.name: Revision number
fields.description: Bit 0=reserved; bit 1=ONFI 1.0; bit 2=ONFI 2.0; bit 3=ONFI 2.1; bit 4=ONFI 2.2; bit 5=ONFI 2.3; bit 6=ONFI 3.0; bit 7=ONFI 3.1; bit 8=ONFI 3.2; bit 9=ONFI 4.0; bit 10=ONFI 4.1.

fields.name: Features supported
fields.description: 16-bit bitmap: 16-bit data bus support, multiple LUNs, non-sequential page program, multi-plane program/erase, odd-to-even copyback, source synchronous (NV-DDR), interleaved, extended parameter page, programmable I/O drive strength, programmable R/B_n pullup strength, NV-DDR2, NV-DDR3, ...

fields.name: Optional commands supported
fields.description: Bitmap of optional commands: Page Cache Program, Read Cache, Get/Set Features, Read Status Enhanced, Copyback, Read Unique ID, Change Read Column Enhanced, Change Row Address, Small Data Move, Reset LUN, ZQ Calibration Long, ZQ Calibration Short, ODT Configure, Volume Select.

fields.name: Extended parameter page length
fields.description: Number of 16-byte units in Extended Parameter Page (0 = none).

fields.name: Number of parameter pages
fields.description: Total number of parameter page copies (≥ 3).

fields.name: Number of data bytes per page
Number of spare bytes per page
Number of data bytes per partial page
Number of spare bytes per partial page
Address cycles
fields.description: Bits 7:4 = row address cycles; bits 3:0 = column address cycles.

fields.name: Guaranteed valid blocks at beginning of target
Block endurance for guaranteed valid blocks
Multi-plane operation attributes
fields.description: Bitmap: lower bit row address restrictions, no multi-plane same plane, etc.

fields.name: Timing mode support (SDR)
fields.description: Bit n = SDR timing mode n supported.

fields.name: tPROG (max)
fields.description: Max page program time in microseconds.

fields.name: tBERS (max)
fields.description: Max block erase time in microseconds.

fields.name: tR (max)
fields.description: Max page read time in microseconds.

fields.name: tCCS (min)
fields.description: Min change-column setup time in nanoseconds.

fields.name: NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 features
fields.description: Bitmap of differential RE_n/DQS, NV-DDR2 warmup cycles, etc.

fields.name: NV-DDR2 timing mode support
fields.description: Bit n = NV-DDR2 timing mode n supported.

fields.name: NV-DDR timing mode support
fields.description: Bit n = NV-DDR timing mode n supported.

fields.name: NV-DDR2/3 features
fields.description: Bitmap of CLK stop during burst, warmup cycles, ZQ calibration, etc.

fields.name: NV-DDR2/3 warmup cycles
fields.description: Bits 3:0 = output warmup cycles; bits 7:4 = input warmup cycles.

fields.name: NV-DDR3 timing mode support
fields.description: Bit 0 = modes 0-3, bit 1 = mode 4, ..., bit 9 = mode 12.

fields.name: Integrity CRC
fields.description: 16-bit CRC over bytes 0-253; polynomial 8005h, initial 4F4Eh, no XOR, no bit reversal.

registers.name: Extended Parameter Page
registers.access: Read after the Parameter Page redundant copies (offset = number_of_param_pages × 256).
registers.description: Present when the 256-byte Parameter Page cannot describe all device capabilities. Signature 'EPPS' (45h, 50h, 50h, 53h) at bytes 2-5. Sectioned format with section types: 0 = unused/end, 1 = additional section types & lengths, 2 = Extended ECC Information.

fields.name: Integrity CRC
fields.description: CRC over bytes 2 to end; same polynomial 8005h, initial 4F4Eh.

fields.name: Section data
fields.description: Sections in order; section type 2 = Extended ECC information (8 bytes per block: byte 0 = number of bits ECC correctability; byte 1 = codeword size; bytes 2-3 = bad blocks max per LUN; bytes 4-5 = block endurance).

registers.name: Unique ID
registers.access: Read via Read Unique ID (EDh + 00h); 16 copies of {16-byte UID + 16-byte complement} = 512-byte total burst.
registers.description: Combined with manufacturer ID, the UID uniquely identifies a device. Host validates a copy by checking UID XOR complement == all ones; iterates through copies on mismatch.

registers.name: Feature Parameter File
registers.access: Read via Get Features (EEh + feature_address); Write via Set Features (EFh + feature_address + 4 P-bytes).
registers.description: Four-byte parameter (P1, P2, P3, P4) per feature address. Feature addresses: 01h Timing Mode (ONFI 2.0+); 02h NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 Configuration (bus width, etc.); 10h I/O Drive Strength; 30h ECC Configuration (EZ NAND); 39h External Vpp Configuration; 58h Volume Configuration; 80h-81h EZ NAND control; 08h-0Bh DCC / Read DQ Training / Write TX DQ Training.

fields.name: Timing Mode
fields.description: P1 = data interface (0 SDR / 1 NV-DDR / 2 NV-DDR2 / 3 NV-DDR3) + timing mode.

fields.name: NV-DDR2/3 Configuration
fields.description: Differential signaling, warmup cycles, complementary RE_n/DQS, ODT settings.

fields.name: External Vpp Configuration
fields.description: Enable optional Vpp for improved Program/Erase efficiency.

fields.name: DCC / Read DQ / Write TX DQ training settings

registers.name: ID Bytes (Read ID 90h)
registers.access: Read via Read ID (90h + address). Address 00h returns ≥ 4 bytes; address 20h returns 'ONFI' signature; address 40h returns 'JEDEC' signature.
registers.description: Address 00h: byte 0 = Manufacturer ID (JEDEC), byte 1 = Device ID, bytes 2-3 = vendor-defined. Address 20h: 'ONFI' = 4Fh 4Eh 46h 49h. Address 40h: 'JEDEC' = 4Ah 45h 44h 45h 43h.

registers.name: Volume / Volume Address
registers.access: Programmed via Set Features (EFh + 58h) during enumeration; selected via Volume Select (E1h + Volume Address byte).
registers.description: Up to 4-bit Volume Address selects one of up to 16 targets sharing one CE_n. Enumeration uses ENi/ENo daisy chain; each volume is appointed a unique address.
